prompt: The video begins with a first-person perspective moving steadily forward along a dimly lit pathway in East Maddon Park, London, under a heavy rain shower at night. The camera advances smoothly, capturing the wet, reflective surface of the path that glistens under the soft glow of evenly spaced street lamps lining both sides. As the viewer progresses, the surrounding trees loom large, their dark silhouettes barely discernible against the misty backdrop. The camera angle remains level, offering a consistent view of the path ahead, which gradually curves to the right. The ambient light from the lamps casts a warm, yellowish hue, contrasting sharply with the cool blue tones of the rainy night sky. Raindrops continuously fall, creating a rhythmic pattern on the ground and adding a layer of texture to the scene. The environment remains empty, devoid of any human presence, enhancing the sense of solitude. The camera continues its steady advance, navigating through the park's serene yet somber atmosphere, until it reaches a set of stairs leading upwards, marking a subtle change in elevation and direction. Throughout the sequence, the focus remains on the interplay of light, shadow, and rain, capturing the tranquil yet eerie essence of a rainy night in an urban park.
location: East Maddon Park, London, United Kingdom
